chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Did any of your ancestors fast in Shaban?' He said, 'The best of my ancestors is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), he fasted in it.'

key_terms.شَعْبَانَ: The eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar
key_terms.صَامَهُ: He fasted in it (referring to the month)

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad fast in the month of Shaban according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal* highlights the Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him) voluntary fasting in Shaban, a practice notably emphasized in Shia tradition as a preparation for Ramadan. By affirming this through the chain of the Imams, the hadith underscores the continuity of prophetic sunnah within the Ahl al-Bayt, encouraging believers to emulate the Prophet’s spiritual readiness during this month.
